functional_chain.mechanism: A fixed sensor reads actual two-bit state at (52,48,47) at q-1. Threat +Z and harmless +X can both produce state1; cue identity, stage, danger label and future are not actor inputs.

Identity scalar enters datum offset(-1,0,+1) at q+3; one fixed q+4 Native SEM1 directional signature is held to q+6. Reference-bank history, not a Python threshold, should determine the physical sign.
+1 schedules one fixed -Z packet at(52,48,51),q+7; -1 and zero do not schedule it. Zero has canonical -1 efference. NULL is invalid and is not silently converted to a trained binary choice.

In the threat condition, the admitted counterflow may interrupt a persistent +Z carrier before the inherited FI challenge. With a legitimate +X packet, same-register/same-tick pulse and message receive terminal Native conflict receipts; actual reader delivery defines the information cost.
One fixed boolean evaluates the actual FI physical result and actual required packet delivery; it does not classify the selected action as correct. The outcome API has no action or bank parameter.

An actual motor efference at q+7 remains a physical eligibility carrier for six N67 laps; generic return at q+408 may collide with it and modify one bank at the prepared contact phase. The host does not look up the earlier choice when returning the outcome.

important_limits: With a scalar0/1 and one threshold, the prepared circuit cannot express arbitrary inversions of both contexts. The planned reversal changes the utility of the same observed state1; context0 stays an innocuous prepared opportunity.

Simultaneously mixing threat and harmless state1 trajectories would make different required actions perceptually indistinguishable to this sensor. The changed relation therefore uses blocks and history; report what can and cannot be inferred from that design.
A missed +Z carrier can persist. A schedule cue=none only means no new cue was supplied, not that all harmful physical history was removed. Preserve and observe that history; do not clean or reset.
Fixed782 credit timing is not a universal phase67 match. Compare actual FI q and material carrier phase; a phase-dependent recovery without changed selection is not learned regulation.

The proposed reserve data still use positive FI comparisons only. Negative and zero inherited functions require their separate preservation panel; this environment predicate must not reward a positive answer on an inherently negative problem.

The host starts opportunities, makes the identity measurement, translates the output into one actuator, runs the inherited FI sequence and measures outcomes. Native should select and acquire the local policy. That would not demonstrate autonomous initiation or discovered multistep planning.
The protocol is presently sealed only for viability. No acquisition, reserve success, selective abstention, reversal, incorporation or principal advancement has been observed by this agent.
